(
  (define-fun inv ((x!0 (Array Int Int))
   (x!1 (Array Int Int))
   (x!2 Int)
   (x!3 Int)) Bool
    (let ((a!1 (not (>= (+ x!2 (* (- 1) x!3)) 1)))
          (a!2 (<= (+ (select x!0 x!3) (* (- 1) (select x!1 x!3))) (- 1)))
          (a!3 (>= (+ (select x!0 x!3) (* (- 1) (select x!1 x!3))) 1)))
      (and (or a!1 (not a!2)) (or a!1 (not a!3)))))
)
